title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of tiles seen from above and in front. A red sphere token starts on the bottom-left square. A green raised disc marks the goal on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons (or arrow keys) move the token one square. Hint shows an orange arrow from the token toward a move that brings it one step closer to the goal. Readouts show moves made and steps to goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the green goal square at the top-right.
game.hint: Steps to goal = rows apart + columns apart. The shortest route takes 4 moves: any order of 2 Ups and 2 Rights.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
A move off the board does nothing and is not counted. The hint arrow stays until your next move. Reset always returns to the same start square.
